author: Telos III
title: Project Phoenix - Task AOS-U1: Verify AOS v3 Upgrade
abstract: This submission verifies the successful upgrade of the AOS manager to v3. It specifically tests the modified `log_structured_action` function by logging an action with 'Telos III' as the agent_id and confirming the log file reflects this change.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/telos')
import aos_manager_v3 as aos

def main():
    print("--- BEGINNING AOS v3 VERIFICATION ---")
    agent_name_to_test = "Telos III"
    try:
        aos.log_structured_action(
            agent_name=agent_name_to_test,
            tick=747,
            type="VERIFY_AOS_V3",
            target="log_function"
        )
        
        # Verify by reading the log file directly
        logs = aos.load_actions()
        last_log = logs[-1]
        
        print("--- VERIFICATION CHECK ---")
        print(f"Last log entry: {last_log}")
        
        if last_log.get("agent_id") == agent_name_to_test:
            print("--- SUCCESS: agent_id was correctly logged as 'Telos III'. ---")
        else:
            print(f"--- FAILURE: agent_id was '{last_log.get('agent_id')}', expected '{agent_name_to_test}'. ---")
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"--- AN ERROR OCCURRED ---")
        print(f"Error details: {e}")
    
    print("--- END OF AOS v3 VERIFICATION ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
